$comment: The only hand-written part of the token catalog. One entry per token whose role the source comment cannot state on its own. `purpose` is the role sentence shown in the catalog; `stability` is alpha unless a token has been deliberately settled.

--ds-color-background.purpose: The page behind everything. Nothing is painted under it.

--ds-color-border.purpose: The line that separates one area from another: dividers, table rules, the edge of a panel. The visible edge of a control is a different job and is under review.

--ds-color-surface.purpose: Anything that sits on the page as its own area: cards, panels, menus, the inside of a field.

--ds-color-surface-hover.purpose: The same area while the pointer is over it, or while it is the active row of a list.

--ds-color-text.purpose: Ordinary reading text on background or surface.

--ds-color-text-secondary.purpose: Text that supports the main text: hints, captions, units. Still has to reach 4.5:1.

--ds-color-disabled.purpose: The fill of a control that cannot be used right now.

--ds-color-text-disabled.purpose: The text of a control that cannot be used right now. It is exempt from the contrast minimum, so never carry meaning by this colour alone.

--ds-color-focus-ring.purpose: The colour of the ring that shows where the keyboard is. It needs 3:1 against whatever it is drawn on.

--ds-state-hover.purpose: The overlay laid over a control while the pointer is on it.

--ds-state-pressed.purpose: The overlay laid over a control while it is being pressed.
